Privacy Policy

Spills · Last updated November 9, 2026

Short version: Spills has no accounts and no servers of its own. Your progress stays on your phone. If ads are shown, Google's ad service receives device and usage information to serve them, and on iPhone you choose whether it may track you.

What stays on your device

Your levels, stars, settings, and refills and skips are saved only on your device. We never receive them. Deleting the app deletes them.

Purchases

Purchases are handled by Apple (App Store) or Google (Google Play). We never see your name, payment details or Apple / Google account. We only receive confirmation that a purchase happened, so the game can give you the item.

Ads

Spills may show ads, provided by Google AdMob. To show and measure ads, Google may collect:

  • device identifiers, such as the advertising identifier (IDFA on iPhone, only if you allow tracking; Android advertising ID);
  • your IP address and approximate location derived from it;
  • information about ad views and taps, app interactions, and crashes or performance.

On iPhone, Spills asks before allowing tracking. If you choose "Ask App Not to Track", you still see ads, but they aren't personalized from your activity in other apps and websites. In the European Economic Area, the UK and Switzerland, a consent form lets you choose how your data is used for ads. Buying Remove Ads or the Starter Bundle turns off ads between levels.

Google's use of this data is covered by Google's Privacy Policy and how Google uses information from apps that use its services.

Game settings download

When it opens, Spills downloads a small settings file (for example, whether an update is required) from GitHub Pages. Like any website, GitHub may log your IP address when it serves that file. No personal information is sent.

Children

Spills is a general audience game and is not directed at children under 13. We don't knowingly collect personal information from children.

Your choices

  • Turn tracking on or off at any time in Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking (iPhone).
  • Reset or delete your advertising ID in your device settings.
  • Delete the app to remove all game data stored on your device.

Changes

If this policy changes, the new version will be posted on this page with a new date.

Contact

Questions? Email spills.support@gmail.com or visit the support page.
